geometryStatuses.NO_GEOMETRY_SOURCE_NAME_ONLY: No reviewed candidate identity or research footprint.
geometryStatuses.RESEARCH_ANCHOR_POINT: Historical centre or site anchor for research audit only.
geometryStatuses.RESEARCH_MULTI_ANCHOR: Several evidence-backed centres; none is an authoritative region proxy.
geometryStatuses.RESEARCH_CORRIDOR_OR_RIVER_SYSTEM: River/system context without an inferred land polygon.
geometryStatuses.RESEARCH_BROAD_UNCERTAINTY_ENVELOPE: Coarse historical-region envelope, never a modern administrative boundary.
geometryStatuses.CONTESTED_RESEARCH_GEOMETRIES: Separate alternatives; no merged or preferred geometry.
geometryStatuses.GEOMETRY_PENDING_EVIDENCE: Candidate identity exists but footprint evidence is insufficient.
geometryStatuses.GEOMETRY_PROHIBITED: Source-name-only or too ambiguous for a footprint.
